summary: Jamaican-Canadian Pentecostal preacher Kevin O. Smith fled a Canadian sexual assault conviction, built a lucrative prosperity-gospel sect in Montego Bay, and in 2021, gripped by COVID vaccine paranoia, directed the killing of congregants.

evidence.note: Birth year given as probably 1982, with some sources suggesting the late 1980s
Family emigrates from Jamaica to Canada in the mid-1990s; he starts preaching in Toronto
Long segment on the unaccredited Vision International University and its UK accreditor
2006 sexual assault of an escort in Toronto, followed by a 2007 conviction
Breaks probation, leaves Canada and sets up his church in Jamaica
Prosperity gospel history and the church's layered offerings, fees and loans
COVID lockdowns push him into anti-vaccine conspiracy preaching
Killings at the Ark in October 2021, then a shootout with police
Dies in a car crash while in police custody less than two weeks later

notes: Birth year is uncertain (transcript: probably 1982), so time is approximate. Smith was also a Canadian citizen, which is why CA is in origin. JM-08 (Saint James) is given for Montego Bay. Apostolic Faith and Azusa Street history is background and does not count toward covered_span. Child-abuse was left out: Jivon's isolation at 17 and Smith's own childhood abuse get only brief treatment.
